schistos , a, on, adj., = σχιστός,
I.split, cleft, divided; a t. t. in Pliny the Elder: lapis, that easily cleaves or cracks, fissile, schistose, a name given to a kind of red oxide of iron, Plin. 29, 6, 38, § 124; 33, 4, 25, § 84; 36, 20, 37, § 144: “lac,” i. e. curdled, id. 28, 9, 33, § 126 : “caepa, a peculiar kind,” id. 19, 6, 32, § 101 : “alumen,” id. 31, 7, 39, § 79 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
